description: This file defines part of an experimental API for PyTorch Distributed, including process group registration, creation, and context management. It provides interfaces and implementations for different backend process groups (GLOO and NCCL), and utilities to manage process groups within a distributed environment.

classes.name: ProcessGroupFactory
classes.description: Protocol interface for creating process groups.

methods.description: Registers a new process group backend with a specified name and factory function.

methods.description: Factory function to create a Gloo backend process group.

methods.description: Factory function to create an NCCL backend process group.

methods.name: ProcessGroup new_group( backend: str, timeout: timedelta, device: str | torch.device, **kwargs: object, )
methods.description: Creates a new independent process group with specified backend, timeout, and device.

methods.name: ProcessGroup current_process_group()
methods.description: Returns the current process group in thread-local context.

methods.name: Generator[None,None,None] process_group(pg: ProcessGroup)
methods.description: Context manager that temporarily sets the given process group as current.
